summary: This Form 6-K filed by Veraxa Biotech Holding AG announces the completion of its business combination with Voyager Acquisition Corp., a SPAC sponsored by Cantor Fitzgerald and others. The transaction closed on June 10, 2026, after shareholder approvals in March and February 2026. Veraxa merged into Veraxa Biotech AG, listing shares and warrants on Nasdaq under VRXA and VRXAW. The filing discloses a $27.5 million secured note and a $50 million share purchase agreement to fund pipeline development. No deal value, premium, or advisor is stated. The de-SPAC creates a publicly traded biopharma focused on bispecific TCEs and ADCs. Watch for post-merger trading volume and execution of clinical milestones.
